domains.name: Ground Station
domains.description: Frontend and backend systems that receive telemetry and images, provide dashboard and storage.

domains.name: On-board Computer
domains.description: Firmware running on the CanSat that captures sensor data and images and sends them to the ground station.

domains.name: Utilities
domains.description: Shared utilities and emulation tools used for development and testing.

flows.name: Image Capture Flow
flows.description: Capture image on the on-board computer, transmit to ground station, backend saves image and frontend displays progress.

steps.title: Capture Image
steps.description: Firmware captures an image and queues it for transmission

steps.title: Transmit Image
steps.description: On-board sends image data to ground station via radio/link

steps.title: Receive & Persist
steps.description: Backend receives image and saves partial/complete files

steps.title: Display Progress
steps.description: Frontend shows upload progress and displays the completed image

flows.name: Telemetry Flow
flows.description: Sensors read data on-board, stream telemetry to backend, and frontend consumes for charts.

steps.title: Send Telemetry
steps.description: On-board packages telemetry and sends to ground

steps.title: Ingest Telemetry
steps.description: Backend or mock tools parse telemetry into store
